source_receipt_API: RootComponentSourceReceiptRegistry.record_verified_generation(verified_source:VerifiedComponentSource,verified_generation:VerifiedComponentGeneration)->opaque handle root-private; reopens full private GenerationStore manifest/files/modes, checks exact selected upstream pin/lock/license/current generation. Record fields schema,handle,application_id,source_identity,source_revision,source_tree_sha256,generation_id,generation_manifest_sha256,service_generation_digest,issued_monotonic,expires_monotonic. Paths remain root-private. Source proof alone does not authorize execution.
runtime_receipt_API: RootApplicationRuntimeReceiptRegistry.record_observed_environment(selected_source_receipt_handle,selected_locked_runtime,actual_managed_probe)->opaque handle root-private. Actual root selected isolated dependency environment manifest plus terminal managed version/ABI/platform/import origins and exact locked dependency artifacts required; RuntimeReview or raw root Path is not a runtime receipt. Record schema,handle,application_id,source_receipt_handle,runtime_id,runtime_manifest_sha256,lock_sha256,python_version,SOABI,machine,platform,dependency_artifact_ids,probe_receipt_handle,service_generation_digest,issued_monotonic,expires_monotonic. Root resolver reopens exact immutable environment, validates member bytes and selected generation before every run. No existing Coral runtime attestation or Hermes PM runtime claimed as component environment.
dispatch_API: RootRuntimeBindings.resolve_selected_application_runtime(application_id,profile_id)->RootSelectedApplicationRuntime; joins active row/source/runtime/root/schema/account/provider/consent selections. AuthorityService.dispatch_selected_application(invocation_context_handle,application_id,canonical_arguments)->RootApplicationRunReceipt; root resolves actual admitted invocation/source closure, exact schema and finite protected operation recipe, issues independent one-use selected task-style grant with distinct controller vs selected application subject, starts only current selected root environment via existing ManagedProcessEffectHandler. No caller roots/runner/argv/capability fields; WorkloadScheduler production constructor consumes root-selected DTOs only.
result_receipt: RootApplicationRunReceipt fields schema,receipt_handle,application_id,profile_id,profile_generation,service_generation_digest,source_receipt_handle,runtime_receipt_handle,operation_id,request_sha256,terminal_receipt_handle,result_capsule_handle,state(complete|failed|cancelled|ambiguous),issued_monotonic,expires_monotonic. Complete requires actual terminal success and selected artifact result validator; source/runtime receipt alone never functional acceptance.
bounds: All IDs use existing strict protected ID validator; SHA fields lowercase64hex; exact unknown/duplicate keys denied. Source/runtime proofs root signed/domain separated or sealed registry objects, receipt currentness and owned file identity mandatory. Missing ARM64, account, license or lazy-download-free locked environment leaves selected action unavailable with exact next step. On-demand local fixtures and original optional Jarvis application are distinct from deferred future JARVIS sources.
evidence: Actual pinned local fixtures via selected source/runtime/operation, changed source/runtime/schema/account/gen/metered budget/argv/root negatives, effect failure and no acceptance from inventory/source alone.
nonrecursive_snapshot_join: Active row omits its containing service_generation_digest. Root resolved DTO/issued runtime receipt attaches the verified enclosing digest after canonical snapshot parsing; receipt records stored outside the enclosing snapshot cannot recursively embed themselves into it. Definition/source/runtime member digests are independently observed prepublication.
